Positions.Position Title: Regional Geographer and Management Information Systems Analyst

Decision Making: Effort is required to make decisions/recommendations on the nature and scope of assigned studies to support Census operations for the assigned region; the verification of collection maps prior to distribution to the field; the resolution of geo-coding, boundary issues and CU types; the content of responses to queries from managers and staff; the need for and content of training courses and/or information sessions to managers; the identification of operationally mailable areas; validation of CU boundaries including CU refine; and delineation of assignments for CLs, FOSs, FOMs and Area Managers for all collection activities including L/L, NRFU, E-NRFU, Collectives, Early Enumeration, Canvasser and Reserves.

Effort is required to structure searches and identify sources of information in order to prepare regular and ad hoc MIS reports. Effort is required to select/apply methodologies to extract/consolidate, manipulate data, and apply/adapt techniques and procedures to reconcile, validate, verify, analyze and present data, identify trends or anomalies and to determine the most appropriate format for presentation of data. Actions taken impact the capability of managers to monitor and track key performance indicators, report on operations and to manage resources.
Decisions/recommendations made affect the efficient and effective operations of Census Field Offices located throughout the region.

In conjunction with Field Operations Project (FOP) and regional Area Managers clarifies directives, provides guidelines and expertise on collective enumeration collection systems, procedures and concepts; provides advice and expertise to CFOs in regard to collective dwelling enumeration strategies and requirements; assists the CFO with assignment planning.

Provides direct support to CFO and RCC managers by attending meetings, providing written material, making telephone calls or assisting to develop specific strategies for collective dwelling enumeration.

Effort is required to make decisions/recommendations on tactical strategies to organize and coordinate Collective dwelling collection activities through the organization and conduct of working groups and committees engaged to review and recommend work methods, procedures and training to support collection activities.

Effort is required to provide interpretation and application of directives and guidelines and technical expertise on collection systems, procedures and concepts to CFOs and to facilitate resolution strategies to address collection requirements in difficult areas and apply targeted strategies.

Effort is required to perform daily analysis of management information reports to monitor costs and field collection progress and make recommendations to management to resolve anomalies and also provide feedback on the success and/or challenges experienced throughout the planning and collection phase in order to assist in the overall evaluation of the Census Program.
Decisions/recommendations made by the incumbent affect the provision of efficient and cost-effective collection services and CFOs compliance to departmental directives.
